body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug


Installing nightly with rocm6.4 requires pytorch-triton-rocm==3.5.0+git7416ffcb
However, pytorch-triton-rocm==3.5.0+git7416ffcb requires rocm version>=7
~~~
pip install --pre torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/rocm6.4
~~~

~~~python
import torch
fn = torch.compile(sum)
fn(torch.rand(10,device="cuda"))
~~~
error:
~~~
torch._inductor.exc.InductorError: RuntimeError: libamdhip64 version 6.4.43484 is not supported! Required major version is >=7.
~~~

workaround runs without errors so far
~~~
pip install pytorch-triton-rocm==3.4.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/rocm6.4
~~~
